summary:
Customers across APAC report noticeable price increases this quarter, with several noting the renewal cost hike was not clearly communicated in advance. Multiple tickets name NimbusCo as a competitor quoting roughly 15% less for comparable packages and allegedly discounting aggressively in the region. As a result, several accounts say they are actively comparing alternatives or evaluating other vendors, and at least one questions whether the current cost aligns with the value received.

Confidence: HIGH

Customers in NA during week 11 expressed positive feedback on new promo pricing and an easy signup process, while another customer inquired about eligibility for a seasonal discount code. No competitor names were mentioned. Sentiment is mixed between positive and neutral inquiry.
Confidence: LOW (only two tickets, limited scope).
